lead: The row above a table: the search box and the conditions ([Query Builder](/query-builder)) on the left, the table's tools ([Table Tools](/table-tools)) on the right, and a "Reset" when something is set. It holds no state: `keyword` and `filter` are yours, and `onSearch` / `onFilterChange` tell you when to ask the list again. Each part shows when its props are given.

usage.title: Search and tools
usage.description: A search box (Enter, the search button and the clear button all call `onSearch`), a Reset when there is something to clear, and the table's tools on the right.

parts.title: With conditions and a row below
parts.description: `fields`, `filter` and `onFilterChange` add the conditions as chips; `below` is a row under the search, on the left, for what belongs to it ("Save as a view"). `children` goes in the search row, after the filter.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: TableToolbar is Flex + SearchInput + QueryBuilder + Button and has no slot of its own.
